newsitem.title: USA: Avalon Group acquires documentary maker.
newsitem.headline: Avalon Group acquires documentary maker.

text.p: The Avalon Group Inc, a medical information products company, said Monday it has acquired Blooming Tree Productions, a documentary production company, for an undisclosed amount.

Blooming Tree Productions has been producing original television programming since 1976. Its commercial products are distributed to Public Broadcasting System affiliates and owner-operated stations domestically, and to more than a dozen countries internationally, Avalon Group said.

"Blooming Tree Productions gives Avalon Group Inc, a professional, experienced broadcast production resource to compliment its current multimedia subsidiary, Interactive Services Inc," Ronald Green, president of Avalon Group, said in a news release.
